auth.howToChange: Login de emergencia del panel. Editá `ADMIN_USER` en el archivo `.env` del server (p. ej. `/home/ploi/skyline-core/.env`) y reiniciá el core: `systemctl restart streamhub-core` (alias en prod: `skyline-core`).

Secreto: solo se informa si está seteado. Editá `ADMIN_PASS` en el archivo `.env` del server (p. ej. `/home/ploi/skyline-core/.env`) y reiniciá el core: `systemctl restart streamhub-core` (alias en prod: `skyline-core`).

Firma los JWT del panel. Secreto: solo se informa si está seteado. Editá `STREAMHUB_JWT_SECRET` en el archivo `.env` del server (p. ej. `/home/ploi/skyline-core/.env`) y reiniciá el core: `systemctl restart streamhub-core` (alias en prod: `skyline-core`).

El magic-link a esta dirección obtiene rol superadmin. Editá `STREAMHUB_SUPERADMIN_EMAIL` en el archivo `.env` del server (p. ej. `/home/ploi/skyline-core/.env`) y reiniciá el core: `systemctl restart streamhub-core` (alias en prod: `skyline-core`).

Requiere host + password. La contraseña nunca se muestra. Editá `STREAMHUB_SMTP_PASS` en el archivo `.env` del server (p. ej. `/home/ploi/skyline-core/.env`) y reiniciá el core: `systemctl restart streamhub-core` (alias en prod: `skyline-core`).

knobs.label: UDP receive buffer max
knobs.why: WebRTC/RTP media arrives over UDP; the ~208 KB default drops packets when several publishers/subscribers saturate the socket. install.sh raises this to 16 MiB.

knobs.label: UDP send buffer max
knobs.why: Send-side counterpart of rmem_max: a small default throttles outbound RTP to subscribers under load. install.sh raises this to 16 MiB.

knobs.label: Listen backlog (somaxconn)
knobs.why: Caps the accept() queue for TCP signalling/HLS/API. A low backlog drops connections during viewer surges (joins after a broadcast starts).

knobs.label: UDP memory ceiling (udp_mem max)
knobs.why: System-wide UDP memory pressure thresholds (min/pressure/max, in pages). A low max column throttles all UDP once media load grows.

knobs.label: Ephemeral port range
knobs.why: A media server holds many relay/outbound sockets; a narrow ephemeral range exhausts ports and refuses new connections.

knobs.label: System-wide file-descriptor cap
knobs.why: Every socket, HLS segment and recording is a file descriptor. A low system cap makes the kernel refuse new fds server-wide under load.

knobs.label: Process open-files limit (ulimit -n)
knobs.remedy: LimitNOFILE=200000 in the systemd unit   # or: ulimit -n 65535
knobs.why: Per-process fd ceiling for the core/LiveKit. Too low and the process hits EMFILE under many concurrent viewers. deploy/*.service set LimitNOFILE high.

knobs.label: Swappiness
knobs.why: High swappiness lets the kernel swap out hot media/jitter buffers, spiking latency and stalls. Keep the media path in RAM.

knobs.label: Transparent hugepages
knobs.why: THP=always causes latency spikes from background compaction — bad for real-time media. `madvise`/`never` avoids the stalls. Optional.

data.note: Non-Linux host: /proc tuning is not inspectable here. These knobs apply on the production Linux host, where install.sh sets them.
